title: Deployment Infrastructure Readiness & Deployment Rehearsal
scope: Q15 Phase F — Testing and final report. Deployment infrastructure readiness rehearsal on staging config. No trading, no live orders, no real exchange credentials, no model retraining/calibration. Source files and Q4-Q14 governance evidence not modified.
architecture_summary: SignalForge deployment architecture is a single-process, loopback-only advisory research platform. Canonical pipeline: exchange (ccxt, public read-only) -> market data -> features -> models -> signals -> risk gates -> results. Configuration lives in config/*.toml (default, staging, development, production) validated by pydantic Settings; secrets only in gitignored .env via META_MUSE_API_KEY env var. The [api] section binds 127.0.0.1:8000 with allow_remote=false and GET-only routes; dashboard is server-rendered HTML with no trading controls. Backup/restore targets config.staging [backup].path = backups; writes are atomic (temp file + os.replace), source dirs read-only, per-file 50 MB cap, SHA-256 manifest. Risk gates are deterministic, fail_closed, independent of models/AI; NO_TRADE is a valid output. No live orders, paper trading, retraining, or public exposure anywhere in the codebase.

security_findings.detail: Real key value never committed to git; .env never tracked; no external provider rotation performed (no provider console access). Classification EXPOSURE_NOT_CONFIRMED. Rotation is precautionary, not a confirmed breach.

security_findings.finding: API binding is loopback-only by default
security_findings.detail: [api] host = 127.0.0.1, port = 8000, allow_remote = false; CORS origins empty; GET-only build assertion enforced; 405s on mutating methods; traversal/ID validation/secret redaction/sanitized errors tested.

security_findings.finding: No hardcoded API keys; no pickle imports in src; .env gitignored
security_findings.detail: Secret scan clean; unsafe deserialization absent; CI secret scanning configured.

security_findings.finding: Backup tamper detection via SHA-256 manifest
security_findings.detail: Backup create + dry-run restore verified (93 files, 0 errors); manifest checksums verified on create.
